item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Develop controlled history-intervention probes through ModelView: remove recent interactions, truncate older history, and shuffle valid events while preserving left padding and final-nonpadding readout. Measure changes in target rank and top-10 recommendations against matched random perturbations, stratified by history length and recency. This could reveal whether HSTU uses specific recent intent or mostly persistent item associations, motivating changes to temporal features or sequence training. Treat these as sensitivity tests, not proof of causal user preferences.","query":"HSTU sequential recommendation temporal sensitivity controlled history perturbation recency order ablation diagnostic evaluation 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Build an evidence-aware recommendation audit addressing compatibility, redundant substitutes, and weakly supported relevance. Use only available titles, descriptions, timestamps, and histories; extract explicit attributes such as connector, format, dimensions, and quantity, while recording missing evidence separately from contradictions. Validate extraction and rejection-reason precision on a small annotated sample. This could distinguish measurable compatibility failures from uncertainty and provide grounded explanations for qualitative feedback without inventing fulfilled needs or user traits.","query":"recommendation diagnostic evaluation product compatibility substitute complement redundancy attribute extraction selective prediction missing evidence 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Replace scale-dependent training margins with a calibrated diagnostic evaluation of one trained HSTU model per category. Investigate paired rank tests across uniform, popularity-stratified, and metadata-similar negatives, plus bounded full-catalog audits for the designated training users. Report sample counts, bootstrap uncertainty, missing evidence, and disagreement with the fixed validation HR@10 protocol. This could expose easy-negative shortcuts and determine which probes reliably identify actionable ranking failures without changing the host evaluator or fitting additional predictors.","query":"sequential recommender diagnostic evaluation sampled negatives full catalog ranking popularity bias hard negatives bootstrap uncertainty 2024 2025 2026"}]}
